confidence_notes: Restaurant and coffee estimates align with recent Honolulu cost-of-living aggregates. The cocktail estimate comes from a sparse collaborative index; wine is estimated at about 1.2 times the local draft-beer price. Lodging figures are broad July model estimates with substantial seasonal and property variation; no live listings were checked.
comparable_city_reasoning: No external comparable city used. Honolulu-specific price aggregates guide food and drink; lodging estimates reflect the city’s island costs and strong tourist demand.
